name: oam
description: Use Amazon CloudWatch Observability Access Manager to create and manage links between source accounts and monitoring accounts by using CloudWatch cross-account observability.

subcommands.name: create-link
subcommands.description: Creates a link between a source account and a sink that you have created in a monitoring account.

subcommands.name: create-sink
subcommands.description: Use this to create a sink in the current account, so that it can be used as a monitoring account in CloudWatch cross-account observability.

subcommands.name: delete-link
subcommands.description: Deletes a link between a monitoring account sink and a source account.

subcommands.name: get-link
subcommands.description: Returns complete information about one link.

subcommands.name: get-sink
subcommands.description: Returns complete information about one monitoring account sink.

subcommands.name: get-sink-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the current sink policy attached to this sink.

subcommands.name: list-attached-links
subcommands.description: Returns a list of source account links that are linked to this monitoring account sink.

subcommands.name: list-links
subcommands.description: Use this operation in a source account to return a list of links to monitoring account sinks that this source account has.

subcommands.name: list-sinks
subcommands.description: Use this operation in a monitoring account to return the list of sinks created in that account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Displays the tags associated with a resource.

subcommands.name: put-sink-policy
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the resource policy that grants permissions to source accounts to link to the monitoring account sink.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Assigns one or more tags (key-value pairs) to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-link
subcommands.description: Use this operation to change what types of data are shared from a source account to its linked monitoring account sink.
